inlines.text: 이 페이지는 지식·교육·기술 도메인의 기계 입력, 검증 순서, 계약 계산, 상태·보존 경계, 오류·보류 경로를 구조 다이어그램으로 보여준다. 원천은 해당 메커니즘 계약과 2026-10-08 전환 지도며, 수치 승인 상태는 원문 계약을 따른다.

소비자 계약(evidence-accumulation-with-optional-assessment-contest): Practice integrates actual unique intervals; assessment contest evidence not automatic +1. Qualification independent. Teacher death releases only reserved-consumed; rubric/factor absence holds candidate.

blocks.text:
F-unused [] reserved-consumed
F-preserve [] progressAfter=progressBefore; skillAfter=skillBefore on interruption/inheritance
REF-EAH-COST [] first CP=1 at offsets E0/A-1/H-2; next offset +1 costs2; next +2 costs4; subsequent +1 adds4
F-growth [proposal-held] null
F-qualification [proposal-held] null
D14-F1 [후보·승인 전] practiceAfter=practiceBefore+sum(unique actualPractice dt*attention*teachingFactor); ratingCandidate=reviewRubric(practiceEvidence,performanceEvidence); no automatic level or CP purchase
D14-F2 [후보·승인 전] teacherDeath: unused=reserved-consumed; requestRelease=unused; consumed and earned progress unchanged; other interruption policies require their own contract

inlines.text: D14의 나머지 계약 잎은 운용 흐름에 연결된 대조 원장으로 보존한다. 역사 참조식과 미결 값은 운용 간선에 넣지 않는다.

items.text: completedStages,progress,proficiency,unspentCP,reserved,consumed — safe nonnegative integer (completed-stage-count / skill-specific-evidence-unit / skill-level / CP / fixture-resource-unit)
studyDuration,cost,practiceToCPRate,teacherEffect,recognitionCriteria,qualificationProcedure — null or separately approved value envelope (held-by-decision)

inlines.text: 자료 소유자는 [object Object], 유지 계약은 F-unused·F-preserve다. 상태 소유 경계는 access,understanding,practice intervals,earned progress,teaching factor,qualification,teacher/tool/place refs,reserved/consumed. 커밋 규칙: Version-bound owner candidate; current grant/consent/receipt guards; preserve quantities/identities/consumed progress; atomic accepted receipt. Exact source contract referenced below.

items.text: 후보 오류: E_POLICY, E_CONSENT, E_INPUT, E_CONSERVATION
기존 평가기 오류: E_TYPE, E_UNIT, E_RANGE, E_RULES_VERSION, E_STALE_SNAPSHOT, E_EVENT_CONFLICT, E_REQUIRED_UNKNOWN, E_REQUIREMENT, E_ACCESS, E_RESERVATION

어댑터 결합 규칙: tagged unresolved -> Held E_UNRESOLVED; malformed missing required key -> Rejected E_INPUT; stale -> E_REVISION; unit -> E_UNIT; conservation -> E_CONSERVATION. Authority/consent/feasibility privately distinct.

inlines.text: 제거 대상 차용 산식: REF-EAH-COST. Remove call/dependency from original operative consumer, not original records/historical references/tests.

inlines.text: 현재 범위 한계: Named helper only; no complete authoritative domain state owner/transaction/consumer workbook. 다음 구현 단위는 U-D14-practice-evidence-assessment(TOOL/tools/mechanisms/original-trpg/practice-evidence-assessment.mjs, TOOL/tools/mechanisms/original-trpg/practice-evidence-assessment.test.mjs). 인물·세계 수치 승인과 별개로, 이 아치파이는 계약 구조만을 보여준다.
